title: arnica mollis var. aspera
intro: Arnica mollis var. aspera, commonly known as Woolly Mountain Arnica, is a perennial plant species native to the mountainous regions of North America. It is valued for its health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing, due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antirheumatic properties. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Mountain Arnica include topical application for the treatment of bruises, sprains, and joint pain, as well as oral consumption for the prevention of scurvy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
